evidence: Plaut. Men. 432: eho Messēniō, accēde hūc.
Ter. Ad. 970: ehō, accēde hūc ad mē
terms.comment: With verbs of motion: “come here” is accēde hūc, venī hūc, not hīc.

phrases.latin: eho Messēniō, accēde hūc. — Quid negōtī est?
phrases.english: Hey, Messenio, come here. — What’s the matter?

phrases.latin: Ostende hūc manūs. — Em tibi, ostendī, eccās.
phrases.english: Show me your hands. — There you are, I’ve shown them: here they are.

sources: Lewis & Short: huc · Lewis & Short: horsum
